---- MODULE OpenAddressing ----
EXTENDS OpenAddressingDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL OAProver == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL OASeq == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems

OAOutside == {"pick", "put", "waitEv", "endWEv", "chkSnc", "cntns",
              "onSnc", "insrt", "isMth", "cas", "tryEv", "waitIns",
              "endEv", "Done"}
OAInside == {"strIns", "nestedIns", "set", "flush", "rtrn"}
OAFrame == [procedure |-> "Evict", pc |-> "endEv",
            ei |-> 1, ej |-> 1, lo |-> 0]

OAControl ==
  /\ pc \in [Writer -> OAOutside \cup OAInside]
  /\ fp \in [Writer -> fps \cup {0}]
  /\ DOMAIN stack = Writer
  /\ DOMAIN ei = Writer
  /\ DOMAIN ej = Writer
  /\ DOMAIN lo = Writer
  /\ \A s \in Writer:
       /\ pc[s] \notin {"pick", "Done"} => fp[s] \in fps
       /\ IF pc[s] \in OAInside
             THEN stack[s] = <<OAFrame>>
             ELSE /\ stack[s] = <<>>
                  /\ ei[s] = 1 /\ ej[s] = 1 /\ lo[s] = 0

OACompletionInv ==
  /\ OAControl
  /\ history \subseteq fps
  /\ CompleteAsSafety

LEMMA OAFrameFacts ==
  /\ Head(<<OAFrame>>) = OAFrame
  /\ Tail(<<OAFrame>>) = <<>>
  /\ <<OAFrame>> \o <<>> = <<OAFrame>>
BY OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF OAFrame

LEMMA OACompletionInit == Init => OACompletionInv
BY OAProver!SMTT("r10")
   DEF Init, OACompletionInv, OAControl, CompleteAsSafety,
       ProcSet, OAOutside, OAInside

LEMMA OACompletionEvict ==
  ASSUME NEW s \in Writer, OACompletionInv, Evict(s)
  PROVE OACompletionInv'
<1>1. strIns(s) => OACompletionInv'
  BY OAProver!SMTT("r10")
     DEF strIns, OACompletionInv, OAControl, CompleteAsSafety,
         ProcSet, OAOutside, OAInside
<1>2. nestedIns(s) => OACompletionInv'
  BY OAProver!SMTT("r10")
     DEF nestedIns, OACompletionInv, OAControl, CompleteAsSafety,
         ProcSet, OAOutside, OAInside
<1>3. set(s) => OACompletionInv'
  BY OAProver!SMTT("r10")
     DEF set, OACompletionInv, OAControl, CompleteAsSafety,
         ProcSet, OAOutside, OAInside
<1>4. flush(s) => OACompletionInv'
  BY OAProver!SMTT("r10")
     DEF flush, OACompletionInv, OAControl, CompleteAsSafety,
         ProcSet, OAOutside, OAInside
<1>5. rtrn(s) => OACompletionInv'
  BY OAFrameFacts, OAProver!SMTT("r10")
     DEF rtrn, OACompletionInv, OAControl, CompleteAsSafety,
         ProcSet, OAOutside, OAInside, OAFrame
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5 DEF Evict

LEMMA OACompletionWriter ==
  ASSUME NEW s \in Writer, OACompletionInv, p(s)
  PROVE OACompletionInv'
<1>1. ASSUME pick(s) PROVE OACompletionInv'
  <2>0. USE <1>1
  <2>1. OAControl'
    BY OAProver!SMTT("r10")
       DEF pick, OACompletionInv, OAControl, OAOutside, OAInside
  <2>2. history' \subseteq fps
    BY OAProver!SMTT("r3") DEF pick, OACompletionInv
  <2>3. CompleteAsSafety'
    <3>1. history' = history /\ pc[s] = "pick"
      BY DEF pick
    <3>2. fps \ history = {} => history = fps
      BY OAProver!SetExtensionality, OAProver!SMTT("r3")
         DEF OACompletionInv
    <3> QED BY <3>1, <3>2, OAProver!SMTT("r5")
      DEF pick, OACompletionInv, OAControl, CompleteAsSafety, ProcSet
  <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3 DEF OACompletionInv
<1>2. ASSUME cas(s) PROVE OACompletionInv'
  <2>0. USE <1>2
  <2>1. OAControl'
    BY OAProver!SMTT("r10")
       DEF cas, OACompletionInv, OAControl, OAOutside, OAInside
  <2>2. history' \subseteq fps
    BY OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF cas, OACompletionInv, OAControl
  <2>3. CompleteAsSafety'
    <3>1. fp[s] \in fps
      BY OAProver!SMTT("r3") DEF cas, OACompletionInv, OAControl
    <3>2. history = fps => history' = fps
      <4>1. history' = history \/ history' = history \cup {fp[s]}
        BY OAProver!SMTT("r3") DEF cas
      <4>2. fps \cup {fp[s]} = fps BY <3>1
      <4> QED BY <4>1, <4>2
    <3> QED BY <3>2, OAProver!SMTT("r5")
      DEF cas, OACompletionInv, OAControl, CompleteAsSafety, ProcSet
  <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3 DEF OACompletionInv
<1>3. waitIns(s) => OACompletionInv'
  BY OAFrameFacts, OAProver!SMTT("r10")
     DEF waitIns, OACompletionInv, OAControl, CompleteAsSafety,
         ProcSet, OAOutside, OAInside, OAFrame
<1>4. (put(s) \/ waitEv(s) \/ endWEv(s) \/ chkSnc(s) \/ cntns(s)
        \/ onSnc(s) \/ insrt(s) \/ isMth(s) \/ tryEv(s) \/ endEv(s))
        => OACompletionInv'
  BY OAProver!SMTT("r20")
     DEF put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt, isMth,
         tryEv, endEv, OACompletionInv, OAControl, CompleteAsSafety,
         ProcSet, OAOutside, OAInside
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4 DEF p

LEMMA OACompletionStep ==
  OACompletionInv /\ [Next]_vars => OACompletionInv'
BY OACompletionEvict, OACompletionWriter, OAProver!SMTT("r10")
   DEF Next, Terminating, vars, ProcSet, OACompletionInv, OAControl,
       CompleteAsSafety

LEMMA OACompletionAlways == Spec => []OACompletionInv
<1>1. Init => OACompletionInv BY OACompletionInit
<1>2. OACompletionInv /\ [Next]_vars => OACompletionInv'
  BY OACompletionStep
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, OAProver!PTL DEF Spec

LEMMA OAModRange ==
  ASSUME NEW x \in Int, NEW k \in Nat \ {0}
  PROVE mod(x,k) \in 1..k
BY OAProver!SMTT("r10") DEF mod

OAData ==
  /\ table \in [1..K -> Int \cup {empty}]
  /\ ei \in [Writer -> Int]
  /\ ej \in [Writer -> Int]
  /\ lo \in [Writer -> Int \cup {empty}]
  /\ external \in Seq(Int)
  /\ newexternal \in Seq(Int)

LEMMA OADataInit == Init => OAData
BY OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF Init, OAData, ProcSet

LEMMA OADataEvict ==
  ASSUME NEW s \in Writer, OAControl, OAData, Evict(s)
  PROVE OAData'
<1>1. strIns(s) => OAData'
  <2>1. mod(ei[s]+1,K) \in 1..K
    BY OAAssumption, OAModRange, OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF OAData
  <2> QED BY <2>1, OAProver!SMTT("r10") DEF strIns, OAData
<1>2. nestedIns(s) => OAData'
  BY OAAssumption, OAModRange, OAProver!SMTT("r10")
     DEF nestedIns, OAData
<1>3. set(s) => OAData'
  BY OAProver!SMTT("r10") DEF set, OAData
<1>4. ASSUME flush(s) PROVE OAData'
  <2>0. USE <1>4
  <2>1. mod(ei[s],K) \in 1..K
    BY OAAssumption, OAModRange, OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF OAData
  <2>2. lo' \in [Writer -> Int \cup {empty}]
    BY <2>1, OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF flush, OAData
  <2>3. table' \in [1..K -> Int \cup {empty}]
    BY <2>2, OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF flush, OAData
  <2>4. external' \in Seq(Int) /\ newexternal' \in Seq(Int)
    BY <2>2, OAProver!SMTT("r10")
       DEF flush, OAData, subSeqSmaller, subSeqLarger
  <2> QED BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF flush, OAData
<1>5. rtrn(s) => OAData'
  BY OAFrameFacts, OAProver!SMTT("r10")
     DEF rtrn, OAData, OAControl, OAInside, OAFrame
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5 DEF Evict

LEMMA OADataWriter ==
  ASSUME NEW s \in Writer, OAControl, OAData, p(s)
  PROVE OAData'
<1>1. cas(s) => OAData'
  BY OAAssumption, OAProver!SMTT("r10") DEF cas, OAData, OAControl
<1>2. waitIns(s) => OAData'
  BY OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF waitIns, OAData
<1>3. (pick(s) \/ put(s) \/ waitEv(s) \/ endWEv(s) \/ chkSnc(s)
        \/ cntns(s) \/ onSnc(s) \/ insrt(s) \/ isMth(s)
        \/ tryEv(s) \/ endEv(s)) => OAData'
  BY OAProver!SMTT("r5")
     DEF pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt,
         isMth, tryEv, endEv, OAData
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF p

LEMMA OADataStep == OAControl /\ OAData /\ [Next]_vars => OAData'
BY OADataEvict, OADataWriter, OAProver!SMTT("r5")
   DEF Next, Terminating, ProcSet, vars, OAData

LEMMA OADataAlways == Spec => []OAData
<1>1. Init => OAData BY OADataInit
<1>2. OAControl /\ OAData /\ [Next]_vars => OAData' BY OADataStep
<1>3. Spec => []OAControl
  BY OACompletionAlways, OAProver!PTL DEF OACompletionInv
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, OAProver!PTL DEF Spec
OAAscending(s) == /\ s \in Seq(Int)
          /\ \A i,j \in 1..Len(s): i<j => s[i]<s[j]
LEMMA OASelectAppend == ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Int), NEW e \in Int, NEW P(_)
        PROVE SelectSeq(Append(s,e),P) =
              IF P(e) THEN Append(SelectSeq(s,P),e) ELSE SelectSeq(s,P)
BY OAProver!SMTT("r5")
LEMMA OASelectElements == ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Int), NEW P(_)
        PROVE \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s,P)):
               \E j \in 1..Len(s): SelectSeq(s,P)[i]=s[j]
<1>1. s \in Seq({s[i]:i \in 1..Len(s)})
 BY OASeq!SeqOfRange, OASeq!LenProperties, OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF OASeq!Range
<1> QED BY <1>1, OAProver!SMTT("r5")
LEMMA OAAscendingAppend ==
 ASSUME NEW s, NEW e \in Int, OAAscending(s),
        \A i \in 1..Len(s): s[i]<e
 PROVE OAAscending(Append(s,e))
BY OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF OAAscending
LEMMA OAAscendingFilter == ASSUME NEW Test(_)
 PROVE \A s \in Seq(Int): OAAscending(s) => OAAscending(SelectSeq(s,Test))
<1>1. OAAscending(<<>>) => OAAscending(SelectSeq(<<>>,Test))
 BY OAProver!SMTT("r3") DEF OAAscending
<1>2. ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(Int), NEW e \in Int,
            OAAscending(s) => OAAscending(SelectSeq(s,Test))
      PROVE OAAscending(Append(s,e)) => OAAscending(SelectSeq(Append(s,e),Test))
 <2>1. OAAscending(Append(s,e)) => OAAscending(s)
  BY <1>2, OAProver!SMTT("r3") DEF OAAscending
 <2>2. OAAscending(Append(s,e)) => \A i \in 1..Len(s): s[i]<e
  BY <1>2, OAProver!SMTT("r3") DEF OAAscending
 <2>3. SelectSeq(Append(s,e),Test) =
         IF Test(e) THEN Append(SelectSeq(s,Test),e) ELSE SelectSeq(s,Test)
  BY <1>2, OASelectAppend
 <2>4. OAAscending(Append(s,e)) => OAAscending(SelectSeq(s,Test))
  BY <1>2, <2>1
 <2>5. \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s,Test)):
         \E j \in 1..Len(s): SelectSeq(s,Test)[i]=s[j]
  BY <1>2, OASelectElements
 <2>6. OAAscending(Append(s,e)) => \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(s,Test)):
          SelectSeq(s,Test)[i]<e
  BY <2>2, <2>5, OAProver!SMTT("r3")
 <2>7. OAAscending(Append(s,e)) => OAAscending(Append(SelectSeq(s,Test),e))
  BY <1>2, <2>4, <2>6, OAAscendingAppend
 <2> QED BY <2>3, <2>4, <2>7
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, OASeq!SequencesInductionAppend
LEMMA OAAscendingConcat ==
 ASSUME NEW s, NEW t, OAAscending(s), OAAscending(t),
        \A i \in 1..Len(s): \A j \in 1..Len(t): s[i]<t[j]
 PROVE OAAscending(s \o t)
BY OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF OAAscending
LEMMA OAAscendingBound ==
 ASSUME NEW s, OAAscending(s)
 PROVE \A i \in 1..Len(s): s[i] <= largestElem(s)
BY OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF OAAscending, largestElem, last
LEMMA OAAscendingMergeSmall ==
 ASSUME NEW s, NEW t, NEW e \in Int, OAAscending(s), OAAscending(t),
        e > largestElem(t)
 PROVE OAAscending(Append(t \o subSeqSmaller(s,t,e), e))
<1>1. OAAscending(subSeqSmaller(s,t,e))
 BY OAAscendingFilter DEF subSeqSmaller, OAAscending
<1>2. \A i \in 1..Len(subSeqSmaller(s,t,e)):
       /\ subSeqSmaller(s,t,e)[i] < e
       /\ subSeqSmaller(s,t,e)[i] > largestElem(t)
 BY OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF subSeqSmaller, OAAscending
<1>3. \A i \in 1..Len(t): t[i] <= largestElem(t)
 BY OAAscendingBound
<1>4. \A i \in 1..Len(t): \A j \in 1..Len(subSeqSmaller(s,t,e)):
       t[i] < subSeqSmaller(s,t,e)[j]
 BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF OAAscending, largestElem, last
<1>5. OAAscending(t \o subSeqSmaller(s,t,e))
 BY <1>1, <1>4, OAAscendingConcat
<1>6. \A i \in 1..Len(t \o subSeqSmaller(s,t,e)):
       (t \o subSeqSmaller(s,t,e))[i] < e
 BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF OAAscending, largestElem, last
<1> QED BY <1>5, <1>6, OAAscendingAppend
LEMMA OAAscendingMergeLarge ==
 ASSUME NEW s, NEW t, OAAscending(s), OAAscending(t)
 PROVE OAAscending(t \o subSeqLarger(s,t))
<1>1. OAAscending(subSeqLarger(s,t))
 BY OAAscendingFilter DEF subSeqLarger, OAAscending
<1>2. t # <<>> => \A i \in 1..Len(subSeqLarger(s,t)):
       subSeqLarger(s,t)[i] > largestElem(t)
 BY OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF subSeqLarger, OAAscending
<1>3. \A i \in 1..Len(t): t[i] <= largestElem(t)
 BY OAAscendingBound
<1>4. \A i \in 1..Len(t): \A j \in 1..Len(subSeqLarger(s,t)):
       t[i] < subSeqLarger(s,t)[j]
 BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF OAAscending, largestElem, last
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>4, OAAscendingConcat
LEMMA OAAscendingSorted ==
 ASSUME NEW s, OAAscending(s)
 PROVE isSorted(s)
<1>1. OAAscending(SelectSeq(s,LAMBDA x: x # empty))
 BY OAAscendingFilter DEF OAAscending
<1> QED BY ONLY <1>1, OAProver!SMTT("r10") DEF OAAscending, isSorted

OAOrder == OAAscending(external) /\ OAAscending(newexternal)

LEMMA OAOrderInit == Init => OAOrder
BY OAProver!SMTT("r3") DEF Init, OAOrder, OAAscending

LEMMA OAOrderFlush ==
  ASSUME NEW s \in Writer, OAControl, OAData, OAOrder, flush(s)
  PROVE OAOrder'
<1>1. OAData' BY OADataEvict DEF Evict
<1>2. (lo'[s] # empty /\ lo'[s] > largestElem(newexternal)) =>
        OAAscending(Append(newexternal \o
                 subSeqSmaller(external,newexternal,lo'[s]),lo'[s]))
  BY <1>1, OAAscendingMergeSmall, OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF OAData, OAOrder
<1>3. OAAscending(newexternal \o subSeqLarger(external,newexternal))
  BY OAAscendingMergeLarge DEF OAOrder
<1>4. OAAscending(<<>>) BY OAProver!SMTT("r3") DEF OAAscending
<1> QED BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, OAProver!SMTT("r5") DEF flush, OAOrder

LEMMA OAOrderOther ==
  ASSUME NEW s \in Writer, OAOrder,
         p(s) \/ strIns(s) \/ nestedIns(s) \/ set(s) \/ rtrn(s)
  PROVE OAOrder'
BY OAProver!SMTT("r5")
   DEF p, pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt,
       isMth, cas, tryEv, waitIns, endEv, strIns, nestedIns, set, rtrn,
       OAOrder

LEMMA OAOrderStep ==
  OAControl /\ OAData /\ OAOrder /\ [Next]_vars => OAOrder'
BY OAOrderFlush, OAOrderOther, OAProver!SMTT("r5")
   DEF Next, Evict, Terminating, ProcSet, vars, OAOrder

LEMMA OAOrderAlways == Spec => []OAOrder
<1>1. Init => OAOrder BY OAOrderInit
<1>2. OAControl /\ OAData /\ OAOrder /\ [Next]_vars => OAOrder'
  BY OAOrderStep
<1>3. Spec => []OAControl
  BY OACompletionAlways, OAProver!PTL DEF OACompletionInv
<1>4. Spec => []OAData BY OADataAlways
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, OAProver!PTL DEF Spec

LEMMA OAOrderImpliesSorted == OAOrder => Sorted
BY OAAscendingSorted DEF OAOrder, Sorted

OAEvictionOwner(s) == pc[s] \in OAInside \cup {"waitIns", "endEv"}
OAOwnership ==
  /\ evict \in BOOLEAN
  /\ evict = (\E s \in Writer: OAEvictionOwner(s))
  /\ \A s,t \in Writer: OAEvictionOwner(s) /\ OAEvictionOwner(t) => s=t

LEMMA OAOwnershipInit == Init => OAOwnership
BY OAProver!SMTT("r3")
   DEF Init, OAOwnership, OAEvictionOwner, OAInside, ProcSet

LEMMA OAOwnershipActions ==
  ASSUME NEW s \in Writer, OAControl, OAOwnership, p(s) \/ Evict(s)
  PROVE OAOwnership'
<1>1. p(s) => OAOwnership'
  BY OAProver!SMTT("r20")
     DEF p, pick, put, waitEv, endWEv, chkSnc, cntns, onSnc, insrt,
         isMth, cas, tryEv, waitIns, endEv, OAControl, OAOwnership,
         OAEvictionOwner, OAInside
<1>2. (strIns(s) \/ nestedIns(s) \/ set(s) \/ flush(s)) => OAOwnership'
  BY OAProver!SMTT("r10")
     DEF strIns, nestedIns, set, flush, OAControl, OAOwnership,
         OAEvictionOwner, OAInside
<1>3. rtrn(s) => OAOwnership'
  BY OAFrameFacts, OAProver!SMTT("r10")
     DEF rtrn, OAControl, OAOwnership, OAEvictionOwner, OAInside, OAFrame
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF Evict

LEMMA OAOwnershipStep ==
  OAControl /\ OAOwnership /\ [Next]_vars => OAOwnership'
BY OAOwnershipActions, OAProver!SMTT("r5")
   DEF Next, Terminating, ProcSet, vars, OAOwnership, OAEvictionOwner

LEMMA OAOwnershipAlways == Spec => []OAOwnership
<1>1. Init => OAOwnership BY OAOwnershipInit
<1>2. OAControl /\ OAOwnership /\ [Next]_vars => OAOwnership'
  BY OAOwnershipStep
<1>3. Spec => []OAControl
  BY OACompletionAlways, OAProver!PTL DEF OACompletionInv
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, OAProver!PTL DEF Spec

\* Common state facts for the remaining representation invariants.
OAStateFacts == OACompletionInv /\ OAData /\ OAOwnership /\ OAOrder

LEMMA OAStateAlways == Spec => []OAStateFacts
BY OACompletionAlways, OADataAlways, OAOwnershipAlways, OAOrderAlways,
   OAProver!PTL DEF OAStateFacts
LOCAL OAFiniteExt == INSTANCE FiniteSetsExtTheorems
LOCAL OAFinite == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems
LEMMA OAFiniteBridge == \A S:
 /\ OAFinite!IsFiniteSet(S) = IsFiniteSet(S)
 /\ OAFiniteExt!IsFiniteSet(S) = IsFiniteSet(S)
 /\ OAFinite!Cardinality(S) = Cardinality(S)
 /\ OAFiniteExt!Min(S) = min(S) /\ OAFiniteExt!Max(S) = max(S)
BY DEF OAFinite!IsFiniteSet, OAFiniteExt!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet,
       OAFinite!Cardinality, Cardinality, OAFiniteExt!Min, OAFiniteExt!Max, min, max
LEMMA OAFingerprintBounds ==
  /\ min(fps) \in fps /\ max(fps) \in fps
  /\ \A f \in fps: min(fps) <= f /\ f <= max(fps)
<1>1. fps # {} /\ fps \subseteq Int /\ IsFiniteSet(fps)
 BY OAFiniteBridge, OAAssumption, OAFinite!FS_EmptySet, OAProver!SMTT("r3")
<1>2. OAFiniteExt!Min(fps) \in fps /\ \A f \in fps: OAFiniteExt!Min(fps) <= f
 BY OAFiniteBridge, <1>1, OAFiniteExt!MinIntFinite
<1>3. OAFiniteExt!Max(fps) \in fps /\ \A f \in fps: OAFiniteExt!Max(fps) >= f
 BY OAFiniteBridge, <1>1, OAFiniteExt!MaxIntFinite
<1> QED BY OAFiniteBridge, <1>2, <1>3, OAAssumption, OAProver!SMTT("r3")
LEMMA OAFingerprintGap == max(fps) - min(fps) \in Nat \ {0}
<1>1. max(fps) \in Int /\ min(fps) \in Int /\ min(fps) <= max(fps)
 BY OAFingerprintBounds, OAAssumption, OAProver!SMTT("r3")
<1>2. min(fps) = max(fps) => fps = {min(fps)}
 BY OAFingerprintBounds, <1>1, OAAssumption, OAProver!SetExtensionality, OAProver!SMTT("r5")
<1>3. Cardinality({min(fps)}) = 1 BY OAFiniteBridge, OAFinite!FS_Singleton
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, OAAssumption, OAProver!SMTT("r3")
LEMMA OAIndexType == ASSUME NEW f \in fps, NEW j \in Int
 PROVE idx(f,j) \in 1..K
<1>1. (K-1) \div (max(fps)-min(fps)) \in Int
 BY OAFingerprintGap, OAAssumption, OAProver!SMTT("r3")
<1>2. (((K-1) \div (max(fps)-min(fps))) * (f-min(fps)+1)) + j \in Int
 BY <1>1, OAFingerprintBounds, OAAssumption, OAProver!SMTT("r3")
<1> QED BY <1>2, OAModRange, OAAssumption, OAProver!SMTT("r3") DEF idx, rescale
LEMMA OAContainsInit == Init => Contains
 BY OAIndexType, OAAssumption, EmptyNotInt, OAProver!SMTT("r10")
 DEF Init, Contains, contains, isMatch, ProcSet
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Spec => []CompleteAsSafety
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF OpenAddressing/OpenAddressing_CompleteAsSafety.tla
BY OACompletionAlways, OAProver!PTL DEF OACompletionInv
\* END AGENT PROOF OpenAddressing/OpenAddressing_CompleteAsSafety.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Consistent
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF OpenAddressing/OpenAddressing_Consistent.tla
<1>1. Init => Consistent
  BY OAProver!SMTT("r3") DEF Init, Consistent, FindOrPut
<1>2. ASSUME OAStateFacts, Consistent, [Next]_vars
      PROVE Consistent'
